From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@zenpoint.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: CAIQ review + sample logs

Hi David,

Thanks for taking this on. ZenPoint is running a quick vendor CAIQ review and we wanted to schedule a short walkthrough of your answers and ask for some sample logs (auth + audit) to validate retention and redaction controls. Proposed goals for the call:
- Walk through CAIQ sections where we have clarifying questions (IAM, logging, key management)
- Confirm typical retention windows and log export formats
- Agree on a small set of sample artifacts we can pull for our security team (no PII)

Our team is available Wed 8/20 between 10:00–13:00 PDT or Thu 8/21 14:00–16:00 PDT. Can you confirm a 30–45m slot? Also, if you can pre-populate the CAIQ we sent, that would speed things up — we uploaded the template to the shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AbCdEfG-zenpoint-evidence

Thanks,
Alice Chen
Security Program Manager
ZenPoint, Inc.
[security@zenpoint.com]

Hi Alice — thanks for the note and the window. Wed 8/20 10:30–11:00 PDT works for our security lead and me. I've tentatively reserved that slot (calendar invite attached).

Quick notes ahead of the call:
- We'll attach a completed CAIQ export (partial) and a sanitized logging sample set (auth/audit events only).
- For the sample logs: we'll remove any PII and redact token values; expected format is gzipped JSON lines.
- Retention: default platform logs retained for 90 days; longer retention is configurable for Dedicated customers — we’ll call out the exact retention for your tenant during the call.

Marissa — can you confirm the artifacts I should attach by EOD Tue? Ben, FYI in case you want to join for the log discussion.

Best,
David Kim
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference
[david.kim@redwoodinference.com]

Marissa / Ben — forwarding Alice's email and the confirmed slot (Wed 8/20 10:30 PDT). Action items before the call:
1) Finalize CAIQ answers for sections: A.1 (IAM), A.6 (Key Management), B.3 (Encryption in transit at the API layer).
2) Prepare a sanitized log bundle: auth_events.jsonl and audit_events.jsonl, gzipped. No PII, remove any customer identifiers; include a short README describing fields and retention window.
3) Prepare one-liner descriptions for our retention policy and how Dedicated tenants can extend retention.

Target deliverables to upload to the ZenPoint Drive folder by Tue 8/19 17:00 PDT:
- CAIQ_Template_Filled.xlsx (partial where applicable)
- redwood-logging-sample-2025-07.tar.gz (contains auth_events.jsonl, audit_events.jsonl, README.txt)

If we can't meet the EOD upload, we'll at minimum drop the CAIQ and the README so ZenPoint can review ahead of the call. Let me know if you need help redacting or if Ben wants the log pull query.

Thanks,
David

Thanks — this looks great. Confirming Wed 8/20 10:30 PDT (I accepted the calendar invite). We received the preliminary CAIQ and README in the shared folder and were able to glance through the logging sample — thank you for the fast turnaround. A couple quick clarifications for the call:
- In the CAIQ you marked key rotation as "automated" — can Marissa or David push a short note on rotation cadence and whether HSM-backed keys are used for production?
- The README indicates 90d default retention; could you also confirm whether logs can be exported to customer-owned S3 for long-term archival (ZenPoint prefers S3 exports for long retention)?

Attachments from our side: none — we'll bring the internal reviewers. If helpful, we'll share the list of CAIQ questions we plan to focus on before the call.

Looking forward to the walkthrough.
